$comment: The one record of which vendored schema versions are kept in sync with the reference implementation, and of their status.

Read by generate-docs.py (which versions to render, and which one is the latest STABLE) and by scripts/check-schema-drift.py (which versions must equal the reference implementation's latest release, byte for byte).
latestStable is deliberately separate from the highest version number: a preview has the higher number and is never 'latest'.

check-schema-drift.py fails when this file disagrees with the release it compares against (a new bundled version, a preview promoted to stable), so editing it is part of every re-vendor, not a separate chore.

upstream.ref and upstream.commit are the forge-cli release the synced schemas were vendored from, and the one check-schema-drift.py compares them with. It fetches by the commit, so the result does not change when forge-cli publishes or moves a tag. Moving to a newer release is a change to these two fields, reviewed in a pull request. commit is the peeled commit of the tag (git ls-remote <repo> refs/tags/<tag>^{}), not the annotated tag object.

frozen maps every file under schema/ and specs/ that is NOT generated from a synced schema to its sha256: the versions before 0.7.2, which are not synced, and the HTML pages that earlier renderer releases produced for them. generate-docs.py --check verifies the hashes offline and fails on any file under schema/ or specs/ that is neither synced output nor listed here, so these cannot be edited, and nothing can be added beside them, unnoticed. Changing an entry is a deliberate edit to this file.

notSynced.0.7.1: The reference implementation bundles a different document under the same $id (it adds orchestration, icebergConfig, binding.properties and more). Re-vendoring it would change which documents the published 0.7.1 accepts, so it is a decision for the maintainers rather than a sync, and the published copy is left as it is.
notSynced.0.0.1-0.5.7: Predate the compatibility promise; the reference implementation no longer bundles them.
